spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, title, text FROM (
  SELECT min(timestamp) AS time, concat(agent_name, ' -> ', agent_version) AS title, 'agent version' AS text
  FROM agent_usage WHERE agent_name != '' AND agent_version != '' GROUP BY agent_name, agent_version
  UNION ALL
  SELECT min(timestamp) AS time, concat(skill_name, ' -> ', skill_version) AS title, 'skill version' AS text
  FROM agent_usage WHERE skill_name != '' AND skill_version != '' GROUP BY skill_name, skill_version
) ORDER BY time

spec.title: Tokens by dimension over time
spec.description:
Goal: Compare token footprint across agents, skills, commands, MCP tools, or models over time, with the dimension user-selectable, or see one aggregate line via the "All" option.
Description: Buckets input/output tokens by time and by the metric named for $cost_dimension (agent+version, skill+version, command, mcp_tool_name, or model; a single 'Total' series when $cost_dimension is 'all'), rendering each as a separate ↓/↑ series pair.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    multiIf(
      '$cost_dimension' = 'agent', if(u.agent_name = '', 'main agent', if(u.agent_version = '', u.agent_name, concat(u.agent_name, ' v', u.agent_version))),
      '$cost_dimension' = 'skill', if(u.skill_name = '', 'main agent', if(u.skill_version = '', u.skill_name, concat(u.skill_name, ' v', u.skill_version))),
      '$cost_dimension' = 'command', u.command_name,
      '$cost_dimension' = 'mcp', u.mcp_tool_name,
      '$cost_dimension' = 'all', 'Total',
      u.model
    ) AS metric,
    sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens))) AS in_val,
    sum(u.output_tokens) AS out_val
  FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
    AND multiIf(
      '$cost_dimension' = 'agent', (u.agent_name != '' OR u.skill_name = ''),
      '$cost_dimension' = 'skill', u.skill_name != '',
      '$cost_dimension' = 'command', u.command_name != '',
      '$cost_dimension' = 'mcp', u.mcp_tool_name != '',
      '$cost_dimension' = 'all', true,
      (u.agent_name != '' OR u.skill_name = '')
    )
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
    AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
  GROUP BY time, metric
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT time, concat(metric, ' ↓') AS metric, toInt64(in_val) AS value FROM filtered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time, concat(metric, ' ↑') AS metric, toInt64(out_val) AS value FROM filtered
) ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_1'

spec.title: Spend by user
spec.description:
Goal: Quickly identify which users are driving the most spend right now.
Description: Sums agent_usage.cost and tokens per user_id (resolved to a display name via ai_gateway_users_dict) over the selected range, ranked by cost descending.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  u.user_id,
  any(dictGetOrDefault('ai_gateway_users_dict', 'user_name', u.user_id, '')) AS user_name,
  sum(u.cost) AS cost,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS tokens
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY u.user_id
ORDER BY cost DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_10'

spec.title: Trace (iframe): $session_id
spec.description: Goal: Pilot an alternate rendering of a session's trace - same prompts, replies, tool calls, and sub-agent spawns as the main Trace view - inside an embedded iframe, as a fresh-CSS presentation experiment. Description: Emits one JSON payload per session (summary stats plus the ordered list of trace steps) which the embedded page receives via postMessage and renders on its own.

spec.rawSql:
WITH dedup_messages AS (
  SELECT m2.session_id AS session_id, m2.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    argMax(m2.prompt_text, m2.ingested_at) AS prompt_text,
    argMax(m2.response_text, m2.ingested_at) AS response_text
  FROM agent_messages m2
  WHERE m2.litellm_call_id != '' AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], m2.session_id))
  GROUP BY m2.session_id, m2.litellm_call_id
),
first_ts_in_invocation AS (
  -- TRUE first-event-of-invocation timestamp, over ALL agent_events (not just
  -- prompt-bearing rows) - matches the original's row_number() OVER (...
  -- ORDER BY timestamp) = 1 semantics exactly. A plain GROUP BY min() (no
  -- window, no JSON extraction, no message JOIN) is far cheaper than
  -- replaying that sort per invocation.
  SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.agent_invocation_id AS agent_invocation_id, min(ev.timestamp) AS first_ts
  FROM agent_events ev
  WHERE ev.agent_invocation_id != '' AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ev.session_id))
  GROUP BY ev.session_id, ev.agent_invocation_id
),
first_real_base AS (
  SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.timestamp AS ts,
    ev.agent_invocation_id AS agent_invocation_id,
    JSONExtractString(ev.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') AS prompt_kind,
    (JSONExtractString(ev.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'command'
      AND (position(m.prompt_text, '<transcript>') > 0
        OR position(m.prompt_text, 'This session is being continued from') > 0)
    ) AS is_command_echo,
    startsWith(m.prompt_text, '[tool_result]') AS is_tool_result_continuation,
    startsWith(m.prompt_text, 'The coordinator sent a message while you were working:') AS is_coordinator_message,
    -- Bug fix (mirrors panel-76's own fix - see that panel's prompt_calc CTE
    -- for the full writeup): Claude Code's auto-compact resume turn
    -- re-injects the prior compact call's own summary as the next
    -- "user"-role prompt, wrapped in a leading <system-reminder>...
    -- </system-reminder> block followed by the literal "This session is
    -- being continued from a previous conversation..." marker text. This
    -- is harness-generated resumption context, not anything a human typed,
    -- but falls through to prompt_kind='real' with no dedicated ingest-side
    -- branch - left unfixed here, it would have pulled min_real_ts back to
    -- this resume turn's own timestamp instead of the session's actual
    -- first human message, same class of bug already documented on
    -- first_real's own is_agent_task exclusion above.
    startsWith(
      replaceRegexpOne(m.prompt_text, '(?s)^(?:\s*<system-reminder>.*?</system-reminder>)+\s*', ''),
      'This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context.'
    ) AS is_compact_resume,
    fti.first_ts AS first_ts_in_invocation
  FROM agent_events ev
  LEFT JOIN dedup_messages m ON m.session_id = ev.session_id
    AND ev.litellm_call_id != '' AND m.litellm_call_id = ev.litellm_call_id
  LEFT JOIN first_ts_in_invocation fti ON fti.session_id = ev.session_id AND fti.agent_invocation_id = ev.agent_invocation_id
  WHERE (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ev.session_id))
    AND m.prompt_text != ''
),
first_real AS (
  -- Lean re-derivation of prompt_final's is_real/is_agent_task/min(ts): the
  -- window-based dedup in scoped_events/prompt_calc (first_prompt/first_command
  -- _occurrence_ts) picks ONE representative row per repeated-prompt-text
  -- group for DISPLAY purposes, but it cannot change which row holds the
  -- session's earliest real-prompt timestamp - within any group the first
  -- occurrence already has the smallest ts, so min(ts) over the deduped set
  -- equals min(ts) over the full undeduped is_real set. Computing that here,
  -- straight off agent_events with only ONE cheap window (min-per-invocation,
  -- vs. prompt_calc's three heavier partition-by-JSON-extracted-text windows
  -- plus regex-heavy trunc/raw_args columns it doesn't need), keeps this
  -- session-level scalar's cost far below scoped_events' - important because
  -- every lines_raw branch INNER JOINs first_real, and ClickHouse re-runs a
  -- WITH CTE's subquery on every reference (no materialization), so
  -- previously this scalar alone forced 8 extra full scoped_events passes.
  SELECT session_id, min(ts) AS min_real_ts
  FROM first_real_base
  WHERE prompt_kind IN ('real', 'command', 'interrupted')
    AND NOT is_command_echo AND NOT is_tool_result_continuation AND NOT is_coordinator_message
    AND NOT is_compact_resume
    AND NOT (agent_invocation_id != '' AND ts = first_ts_in_invocation)
  GROUP BY session_id
),
scoped_events AS (
  -- Lean base scan - NO window functions here. first_prompt_occurrence_ts/
  -- first_command_occurrence_ts/rn_in_invocation (dedup + is_agent_task
  -- detection) are consumed ONLY by prompt_calc below, but this CTE is
  -- referenced by 6 different lines_raw/prompt_calc branches - ClickHouse
  -- re-runs a WITH CTE's subquery on every reference (no materialization),
  -- so computing 3 window functions (one needing an actual sort, via
  -- row_number() OVER (... ORDER BY timestamp)) here was paying that cost
  -- 6x for the 5 branches that never touch the result. Moved to
  -- scoped_events_windowed, referenced only by prompt_calc.
  SELECT
    ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.timestamp AS timestamp, ev.tool_name AS tool_name,
    ev.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    ev.agent_invocation_id AS agent_invocation_id, ev.command_name AS command_name,
    ev.status AS status, ev.latency_ms AS latency_ms,
    ev.calculated_type AS calculated_type, ev.calculated_payload AS calculated_payload,
    ev.failed_tool_name AS failed_tool_name, ev.failed_tool_error AS failed_tool_error,
    m.prompt_text AS prompt_text, m.response_text AS response_text,
    pp.plan_text AS plan_text,
    -- raw_args: plain (no HTML entity escaping, no repeat()-padding) preview
    -- of the tool's own display arg - the iframe/JS side does its own
    -- escaping via textContent, so this panel emits raw text only.
    if(ev.tool_name != '' AND ev.tool_name != 'Agent' AND ev.status != 'failure'
        AND ev.calculated_type IN ('tool_call', 'skill_call'),
      if(ev.tool_name IN ('AskUserQuestion', 'ExitPlanMode'), '',
        substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(JSONExtractString(ev.calculated_payload, 'tool_display_arg'), '[ \t\n\r]+', ' '), 1, 110)
      ),
      NULL
    ) AS raw_args,
    -- full_args_attr: raw full arg/plan text (ExitPlanMode's own plan_text,
    -- or the same tool_display_arg used in raw_args) - no truncation, no
    -- HTML-entity escaping.
    if(ev.tool_name != '' AND ev.tool_name != 'Agent' AND ev.status != 'failure'
        AND ev.calculated_type IN ('tool_call', 'skill_call'),
      if(ev.tool_name = 'AskUserQuestion', '',
        if(ev.tool_name = 'ExitPlanMode',
          coalesce(pp.plan_text, ''),
          replaceRegexpAll(JSONExtractString(ev.calculated_payload, 'tool_display_arg'), '[ \t\n\r]+', ' ')
        )
      ),
      NULL
    ) AS full_args_attr,
    if(trimBoth(coalesce(m.response_text, '')) != '',
      multiIf(
        lengthUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(m.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n')) <= 1500,
        replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(m.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n'),
        concat(
          trimRight(
            if(
              extractGroups(substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(m.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n'), 1, 1500), '(?s)^(.*)[ \t\n]')[1] != '',
              extractGroups(substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(m.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n'), 1, 1500), '(?s)^(.*)[ \t\n]')[1],
              substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(m.response_text, '[ \t]+', ' '), '\n{2,}', '\n'), 1, 1500)
            )
          ),
          '...'
        )
      ),
      NULL
    ) AS trunc,
    if(ev.status = 'failure' AND ev.litellm_call_id != '',
      JSONExtractString(ev.calculated_payload, 'error_type'),
      NULL
    ) AS error_type
  FROM agent_events ev
  LEFT JOIN dedup_messages m ON m.session_id = ev.session_id
    AND ev.litellm_call_id != '' AND m.litellm_call_id = ev.litellm_call_id
  ASOF LEFT JOIN plan_proposals pp
    ON pp.session_id = ev.session_id AND pp.captured_at <= ev.timestamp
  WHERE (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ev.session_id))
),
scoped_events_windowed AS (
  -- Windowed companion to scoped_events, referenced ONLY by prompt_calc -
  -- keeps the 3 window functions (dedup min()s + rn_in_invocation's sorted
  -- row_number()) from being recomputed by the 5 lines_raw branches that
  -- never use them.
  SELECT
    ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.timestamp AS timestamp,
    ev.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    ev.agent_invocation_id AS agent_invocation_id, ev.command_name AS command_name,
    ev.calculated_payload AS calculated_payload,
    m.prompt_text AS prompt_text,
    min(ev.timestamp) OVER (
      PARTITION BY ev.session_id, ev.agent_invocation_id, m.prompt_text
    ) AS first_prompt_occurrence_ts,
    min(ev.timestamp) OVER (
      PARTITION BY ev.session_id, ev.agent_invocation_id, ev.command_name,
        JSONExtractString(ev.calculated_payload, 'display_text')
    ) AS first_command_occurrence_ts,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ev.session_id, ev.agent_invocation_id ORDER BY ev.timestamp
    ) AS rn_in_invocation
  FROM agent_events ev
  LEFT JOIN dedup_messages m ON m.session_id = ev.session_id
    AND ev.litellm_call_id != '' AND m.litellm_call_id = ev.litellm_call_id
  WHERE (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ev.session_id))
    AND m.prompt_text != ''
),
usage_by_call AS (
  SELECT u.session_id AS session_id, u.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - 1) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS tok, sum(u.cost) AS cost
  FROM agent_usage u
  WHERE u.litellm_call_id != '' AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  GROUP BY u.session_id, u.litellm_call_id
),
agent_spawn_events AS (
  SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.timestamp AS timestamp,
    ev.agent_invocation_id AS spawner_agent_id
  FROM agent_events ev
  WHERE ev.calculated_type = 'agent_spawn' AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ev.session_id))
),
child_anchor_raw AS (
  SELECT ai.session_id AS session_id, ai.agent_id AS agent_id, se.timestamp AS anchor_ts
  FROM agent_invocations ai
  ASOF LEFT JOIN agent_spawn_events se
    ON se.session_id = ai.session_id AND se.spawner_agent_id = coalesce(ai.parent_agent_id, '')
      AND ai.spawned_at >= se.timestamp
  WHERE (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ai.session_id))
),
child_anchor AS (
  SELECT session_id, agent_id,
    if(any(anchor_ts) = toDateTime64('1970-01-01 00:00:00', 3), NULL, any(anchor_ts)) AS anchor_ts
  FROM child_anchor_raw
  GROUP BY session_id, agent_id
),
session_header AS (
  SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id,
    argMax(gb.git_branch, gb.captured_at) AS git_branch,
    argMax(gb.git_repo, gb.captured_at) AS git_repo,
    min(ev.timestamp) AS first_ts
  FROM agent_events ev
  LEFT JOIN session_git_branch gb ON gb.session_id = ev.session_id
  WHERE (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ev.session_id))
  GROUP BY ev.session_id
),
stats_tokens AS (
  SELECT u.session_id AS session_id, sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - 1) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens))) AS tok_in, sum(u.output_tokens) AS tok_out, sum(u.cost) AS cost_total,
    arrayFilter(x -> x != '', groupUniqArray(u.model)) AS models
  FROM agent_usage u
  WHERE u.model != '' AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  GROUP BY u.session_id
),
agent_names_raw AS (
  SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id, ev.agent_name AS name
  FROM agent_events ev
  WHERE ev.agent_name != '' AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ev.session_id))

  UNION ALL

  SELECT ai.session_id AS session_id, splitByChar('_', ai.subagent_type)[1] AS name
  FROM agent_invocations ai
  WHERE ai.subagent_type != '' AND splitByChar('_', ai.subagent_type)[1] != '' AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ai.session_id))
),
stats_agent_names AS (
  SELECT session_id AS session_id, arrayFilter(x -> x != '', groupUniqArray(name)) AS agents
  FROM agent_names_raw
  GROUP BY session_id
),
stats_skills AS (
  SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id,
    arrayFilter(x -> x != '', groupUniqArrayIf(ev.skill_name, ev.skill_name != '')) AS skills
  FROM agent_events ev
  WHERE (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ev.session_id))
  GROUP BY ev.session_id
),
stats_time AS (
  SELECT ev.session_id AS session_id,
    dateDiff('second', min(ev.timestamp), max(ev.timestamp)) AS dur_sec,
    countIf(ev.tool_name != '') AS n_tools
  FROM agent_events ev
  WHERE (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ev.session_id))
  GROUP BY ev.session_id
),
prompt_calc AS (
  SELECT sr.session_id, sr.timestamp AS ts, sr.litellm_call_id AS litellm_call_id,
    sr.agent_invocation_id AS agent_invocation_id,
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') AS prompt_kind,
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'display_text') AS display_text,
    (JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'command'
      AND (position(sr.prompt_text, '<transcript>') > 0
        OR position(sr.prompt_text, 'This session is being continued from') > 0)
    ) AS is_command_echo,
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'display_arg') AS display_arg,
    JSONHas(sr.calculated_payload, 'judge_ok') AS has_judge_ok,
    JSONExtractBool(sr.calculated_payload, 'judge_ok') AS judge_ok,
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'judge_reason') AS judge_reason,
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'stop_hook_reason') AS stop_hook_reason,
    (sr.agent_invocation_id != '' AND sr.rn_in_invocation = 1) AS is_agent_task,
    startsWith(sr.prompt_text, '[tool_result]') AS is_tool_result_continuation,
    startsWith(sr.prompt_text, 'The coordinator sent a message while you were working:') AS is_coordinator_message,
    -- Bug fix: see first_real_base's own is_compact_resume comment above -
    -- same auto-compact-resume detection, needed again here because
    -- prompt_final's own emitted is_real field (serialized straight into
    -- trace_json for the iframe to render) is computed independently of
    -- first_real_base, off this CTE's columns.
    startsWith(
      replaceRegexpOne(sr.prompt_text, '(?s)^(?:\s*<system-reminder>.*?</system-reminder>)+\s*', ''),
      'This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context.'
    ) AS is_compact_resume,
    substringUTF8(
      trimBoth(
        replaceRegexpAll(
          replaceRegexpOne(
            replaceOne(sr.prompt_text, '[tool_result]', ''),
            '(?s)^(?:\s*<system-reminder>.*?</system-reminder>)+\s*', ''
          ),
          '[ \t\n\r]+', ' '
        )
      ),
      1, 120
    ) AS tool_result_preview
  FROM scoped_events_windowed sr
  WHERE sr.prompt_text != '' AND sr.timestamp = if(
    JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'command',
    sr.first_command_occurrence_ts,
    sr.first_prompt_occurrence_ts
  )
),
prompt_final AS (
  SELECT session_id, ts, litellm_call_id, agent_invocation_id, is_agent_task,
    has_judge_ok, judge_ok, judge_reason, stop_hook_reason, display_arg,
    prompt_kind = 'webpage_content' AS is_webpage,
    prompt_kind = 'suggestion_mode' AS is_sugg,
    prompt_kind = 'judge_call' AS is_judge,
    prompt_kind = 'stop_hook_feedback' AS is_stop_hook,
    prompt_kind = 'title_gen' AS is_title,
    prompt_kind = 'compact' AS is_compact,
    (prompt_kind IN ('real', 'command', 'interrupted') AND NOT is_command_echo AND NOT is_tool_result_continuation AND NOT is_coordinator_message AND NOT is_compact_resume) AS is_real,
    if(is_tool_result_continuation,
      concat('[background] tool result continuation', if(tool_result_preview != '', concat(': ', tool_result_preview), '')),
      if(is_command_echo, '[background] resent context (harness echo of an earlier command)',
        if(is_compact_resume, '[background] compact-resume context (auto-injected conversation summary)', display_text)
      )
    ) AS display
  FROM prompt_calc
),
stats_prompts AS (
  SELECT session_id AS session_id, countIf(is_real AND NOT is_webpage AND NOT is_agent_task) AS n_prompts
  FROM prompt_final
  GROUP BY session_id
),
session_stats AS (
  SELECT st.session_id AS session_id,
    CAST((
      formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sh.first_ts, 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S'),
      st.dur_sec,
      round(coalesce(sk.cost_total, 0), 2),
      toInt64(coalesce(sk.tok_in, 0)),
      toInt64(coalesce(sk.tok_out, 0)),
      coalesce(sk.models, []),
      toInt64(coalesce(pr.n_prompts, 0)),
      toInt64(st.n_tools),
      coalesce(an.agents, []),
      coalesce(sl.skills, []),
      coalesce(sh.git_repo, ''),
      coalesce(sh.git_branch, '')
    ) AS Tuple(
      started_at String, duration_sec Int64, cost Float64, tokens_in Int64, tokens_out Int64,
      models Array(String), prompts Int64, tool_calls Int64, agents Array(String),
      skills Array(String), git_repo String, git_branch String
    )) AS stats
  FROM stats_time st
  LEFT JOIN stats_tokens sk ON sk.session_id = st.session_id
  LEFT JOIN stats_agent_names an ON an.session_id = st.session_id
  LEFT JOIN stats_skills sl ON sl.session_id = st.session_id
  LEFT JOIN stats_prompts pr ON pr.session_id = st.session_id
  LEFT JOIN session_header sh ON sh.session_id = st.session_id
),
lines_raw AS (
  -- tie=1.5: Codex collaboration-mode-change marker.
  SELECT sr.session_id AS session_id,
    if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, sr.timestamp), sr.timestamp) AS sort_ts,
    1.5 AS tie,
    concat('{"tie":1.5,"ts":', toJSONString(formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S')),
      ',"nested":', toString(toUInt8(sr.agent_invocation_id != '')),
      ',"kind":"collab_mode","text":', toJSONString(JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'collaboration_mode_change')),
      '}') AS item_json
  FROM scoped_events sr
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = sr.session_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = sr.session_id AND ca.agent_id = sr.agent_invocation_id
  WHERE sr.timestamp >= fr.min_real_ts AND JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'collaboration_mode_change') != ''

  UNION ALL

  -- tie=2: prompt/comment marker line.
  SELECT pf.session_id AS session_id,
    if(pf.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, pf.ts), pf.ts) AS sort_ts,
    2 AS tie,
    concat('{"tie":2,"ts":', toJSONString(formatDateTime(toTimeZone(pf.ts, 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S')),
      ',"nested":', toString(toUInt8(pf.agent_invocation_id != '')),
      ',"kind":"prompt","text":', toJSONString(pf.display),
      ',"is_agent_task":', toString(toUInt8(pf.is_agent_task)),
      ',"is_webpage":', toString(toUInt8(pf.is_webpage)),
      ',"is_real":', toString(toUInt8(pf.is_real)),
      ',"is_compact":', toString(toUInt8(pf.is_compact)),
      ',"display_arg":', toJSONString(coalesce(pf.display_arg, '')),
      ',"is_judge":', toString(toUInt8(pf.is_judge)),
      ',"has_judge_ok":', toString(toUInt8(pf.has_judge_ok)),
      ',"judge_ok":', if(pf.has_judge_ok, toString(toUInt8(pf.judge_ok)), 'null'),
      '}') AS item_json
  FROM prompt_final pf
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = pf.session_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = pf.session_id AND ca.agent_id = pf.agent_invocation_id
  WHERE pf.ts >= fr.min_real_ts AND NOT pf.is_title AND NOT pf.is_sugg

  UNION ALL

  -- tie=4: judge_reason (auxiliary line right after a judge_call's own tie=2 marker).
  SELECT pf.session_id AS session_id,
    if(pf.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, pf.ts), pf.ts) AS sort_ts,
    4 AS tie,
    concat('{"tie":4,"ts":', toJSONString(formatDateTime(toTimeZone(pf.ts, 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S')),
      ',"nested":', toString(toUInt8(pf.agent_invocation_id != '')),
      ',"kind":"judge_reason","text":', toJSONString(pf.judge_reason),
      '}') AS item_json
  FROM prompt_final pf
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = pf.session_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = pf.session_id AND ca.agent_id = pf.agent_invocation_id
  WHERE pf.ts >= fr.min_real_ts AND pf.is_judge AND pf.judge_reason != ''

  UNION ALL

  -- tie=4: stop_hook_reason.
  SELECT pf.session_id AS session_id,
    if(pf.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, pf.ts), pf.ts) AS sort_ts,
    4 AS tie,
    concat('{"tie":4,"ts":', toJSONString(formatDateTime(toTimeZone(pf.ts, 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S')),
      ',"nested":', toString(toUInt8(pf.agent_invocation_id != '')),
      ',"kind":"stop_hook_reason","text":', toJSONString(pf.stop_hook_reason),
      '}') AS item_json
  FROM prompt_final pf
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = pf.session_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = pf.session_id AND ca.agent_id = pf.agent_invocation_id
  WHERE pf.ts >= fr.min_real_ts AND pf.is_stop_hook AND pf.stop_hook_reason != ''

  UNION ALL

  -- tie=3: commentary line (a tool call whose own response ALSO carried text).
  SELECT sr.session_id AS session_id,
    if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, sr.timestamp), sr.timestamp) AS sort_ts,
    3 AS tie,
    concat('{"tie":3,"ts":', toJSONString(formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S')),
      ',"nested":', toString(toUInt8(sr.agent_invocation_id != '')),
      ',"kind":"commentary","commentary_text":', toJSONString(sr.trunc),
      '}') AS item_json
  FROM scoped_events sr
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = sr.session_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = sr.session_id AND ca.agent_id = sr.agent_invocation_id
  WHERE sr.timestamp >= fr.min_real_ts AND sr.calculated_type NOT IN ('suggestion_mode', 'title_gen', 'transcript_handoff')
    AND NOT (sr.calculated_type = 'judge_call' AND sr.status != 'failure')
    AND NOT (sr.tool_name = '' AND sr.status != 'failure' AND JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'stop_hook_feedback')
    AND sr.tool_name != '' AND trimBoth(coalesce(sr.response_text, '')) != ''

  UNION ALL

  -- tie=3: failure note (a rejected/failed secondary tool call noted on this row).
  SELECT sr.session_id AS session_id,
    if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, sr.timestamp), sr.timestamp) AS sort_ts,
    3 AS tie,
    concat('{"tie":3,"ts":', toJSONString(formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S')),
      ',"nested":', toString(toUInt8(sr.agent_invocation_id != '')),
      ',"kind":"failure","failed_tool_name":', toJSONString(sr.failed_tool_name),
      ',"failed_tool_error":', toJSONString(replaceRegexpAll(sr.failed_tool_error, '[ \t\n\r]+', ' ')),
      '}') AS item_json
  FROM scoped_events sr
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = sr.session_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = sr.session_id AND ca.agent_id = sr.agent_invocation_id
  WHERE sr.timestamp >= fr.min_real_ts AND sr.calculated_type NOT IN ('suggestion_mode', 'title_gen', 'transcript_handoff')
    AND NOT (sr.calculated_type = 'judge_call' AND sr.status != 'failure')
    AND NOT (sr.tool_name = '' AND sr.status != 'failure' AND JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'stop_hook_feedback')
    AND sr.failed_tool_name != ''

  UNION ALL

  -- tie=3: main row - reply/tool/agent_spawn/api_error, ONE branch (matches
  -- original's single CTE-reference count for scoped_events/usage_by_call/
  -- child_anchor - splitting this into 4 branches was tried and measured
  -- WORSE (CTE re-execution multiplication costs more than the wide-tuple
  -- savings it bought); kind-specific fields built via manual JSON
  -- concatenation instead of a Nullable(T) Tuple, so an unused field for a
  -- given kind costs nothing (no Tuple slot materialized at all).
  SELECT sr.session_id AS session_id,
    if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, sr.timestamp), sr.timestamp) AS sort_ts,
    3 AS tie,
    concat('{"tie":3,"ts":', toJSONString(formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S')),
      ',"nested":', toString(toUInt8(sr.agent_invocation_id != '')),
      ',"kind":"', multiIf(sr.status = 'failure', 'api_error', sr.tool_name = '', 'reply', sr.tool_name = 'Agent', 'agent_spawn', 'tool'), '"',
      multiIf(
        sr.status = 'failure',
          concat(',"api_error_type":', toJSONString(coalesce(nullIf(sr.error_type, ''), 'unknown'))),
        sr.tool_name = '',
          concat(',"reply_text":', toJSONString(sr.response_text)),
        sr.tool_name = 'Agent',
          concat(
            ',"agent_spawn_name":', toJSONString(JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'agent_display_name')),
            ',"agent_spawn_description":', toJSONString(coalesce(JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'description'), ''))
          ),
        concat(
          ',"tool_name":', toJSONString(if(lower(sr.tool_name) = 'web_search', 'WebSearch', sr.tool_name)),
          ',"tool_args":', toJSONString(coalesce(sr.raw_args, '')),
          ',"tool_args_full":', toJSONString(coalesce(sr.full_args_attr, ''))
        )
      ),
      ',"duration_ms":', toString(sr.latency_ms),
      ',"tokens":', toString(toInt64(coalesce(u.tok, 0))),
      ',"cost":', toString(round(coalesce(u.cost, 0), 4)),
      '}') AS item_json
  FROM scoped_events sr
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = sr.session_id
  LEFT JOIN usage_by_call u ON u.session_id = sr.session_id AND sr.litellm_call_id != '' AND u.litellm_call_id = sr.litellm_call_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = sr.session_id AND ca.agent_id = sr.agent_invocation_id
  WHERE sr.timestamp >= fr.min_real_ts AND sr.calculated_type NOT IN ('suggestion_mode', 'title_gen', 'transcript_handoff')
    AND NOT (sr.calculated_type = 'judge_call' AND sr.status != 'failure')
    AND NOT (sr.tool_name = '' AND sr.status != 'failure' AND JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'stop_hook_feedback')
    AND NOT (sr.tool_name = '' AND sr.status != 'failure' AND JSONExtractString(sr.calculated_payload, 'prompt_kind') = 'compact')

  UNION ALL

  -- tie=4: AskUserQuestion array elements, one nested line per question.
  SELECT sr.session_id AS session_id,
    if(sr.agent_invocation_id != '', coalesce(ca.anchor_ts, sr.timestamp), sr.timestamp) AS sort_ts,
    4 AS tie,
    concat('{"tie":4,"ts":', toJSONString(formatDateTime(toTimeZone(sr.timestamp, 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S')),
      ',"nested":1,"kind":"ask_user_question","text":', toJSONString(question),
      '}') AS item_json
  FROM scoped_events sr
  INNER JOIN first_real fr ON fr.session_id = sr.session_id
  LEFT JOIN child_anchor ca ON ca.session_id = sr.session_id AND ca.agent_id = sr.agent_invocation_id
  ARRAY JOIN arrayMap(x -> JSONExtractString(x, 'question'), JSONExtractArrayRaw(sr.calculated_payload, 'questions')) AS question
  WHERE sr.timestamp >= fr.min_real_ts AND sr.calculated_type = 'ask_user_question' AND sr.status != 'failure'
)
SELECT ss.session_id AS session_id,
  concat(
    '{"stats":', toJSONString(ss.stats), ',"lines":[',
    arrayStringConcat(
      arrayMap(x -> x.3, arraySort(x -> (x.1, x.2), groupArrayIf((lr.sort_ts, lr.tie, lr.item_json), lr.session_id IS NOT NULL))),
      ','
    ),
    ']}'
  ) AS trace_json
FROM session_stats ss
LEFT JOIN lines_raw lr ON lr.session_id = ss.session_id
GROUP BY ss.session_id, ss.stats
ORDER BY ss.session_id
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_100', max_memory_usage = 3200000000, max_threads = 1

spec.title: Event mix by type
spec.description:
Goal: See at a glance what kind of activity agent_events rows actually are - the AI's real usage mix, not just its cost.
Description: Groups every event in the selected window by calculated_type (tool_call, llm_answer, agent_spawn, etc.) and counts them.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  calculated_type,
  count() AS event_count
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(session_id), '')))
  AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(session_id), '')))
  AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
GROUP BY calculated_type
ORDER BY event_count DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_101'

spec.title: Session complexity distribution
spec.description:
Goal: See the overall shape of session complexity, not just its outliers - are most sessions trivial single-event pings, or is there a real long tail of large multi-step work?
Description: Histogram of log10(event count) per session; log-scaled because session size is heavily right-skewed (p50=p90=1 event), so a raw-count histogram would collapse into one spike.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT

  log10(count()) AS session_event_count_log10
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))

  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(session_id), '')))
  AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(session_id), '')))
  AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
GROUP BY session_id
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_103'

spec.title: Ask-user-question rate
spec.description:
Goal: See how often a task needs to stop and ask a human, a usage pattern unmeasured elsewhere on this dashboard.
Description: Counts calculated_type = 'ask_user_question' events per ${window}-sized time bucket.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    count() AS ask_user_question_count
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND calculated_type = 'ask_user_question'
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], session_id))
    AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(session_id), '')))
    AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(session_id), '')))
    AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR session_id IN (
      SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
      WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
        AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
    ))
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT time, ask_user_question_count
FROM filtered
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_104'

spec.title: Plan-mode adoption
spec.description:
Goal: See how much traction plan mode (ExitPlanMode) has gotten among real sessions, without presenting a handful of rows as a trend.
Description: Distinct sessions with a plan_proposals row in the window, next to total distinct sessions in agent_events over the same window and filters.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(plan_mode.sessions) AS "Plan-mode sessions",
  toString(total.sessions) AS "Total sessions"
FROM (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
  FROM plan_proposals

      AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(session_id), '')))
      AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(session_id), '')))
      AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
      AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR session_id IN (
        SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
        WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
          AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
      ))
      AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
      AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))

    )
) plan_mode,
(
  SELECT count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(session_id), '')))
  AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(session_id), '')))
  AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
) total
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_105'

spec.title: Subagent spawn structure: nested vs main-spawned
spec.description:
Goal: See whether subagent spawns mostly come straight from the main agent, or from another subagent delegating further.
Description: Dedupes agent_invocations to one row per agent_id, then splits by whether its latest parent_agent_id is empty (main-spawned) or set (nested).

spec.rawSql:
WITH deduped AS (
    SELECT
        ai.agent_id,
        argMax(ai.parent_agent_id, (ai.spawned_at, ai.parent_agent_id != '')) AS parent_agent_id
    FROM agent_invocations ai
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT session_id, user_id
        FROM agent_events
        WHERE (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
          AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
          AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
          AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
          AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    ) ev ON ev.session_id = ai.session_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ai.spawned_at)
      AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ai.session_id))
      AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(ai.session_id), '')))
      AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(ai.session_id), '')))
      AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(ai.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
      AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR ai.session_id IN (
        SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
        WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
          AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
      ))
    GROUP BY ai.agent_id
)
SELECT
    if(parent_agent_id IS NULL OR parent_agent_id = '', 'main-spawned', 'nested') AS spawn_kind,
    count() AS spawn_count
FROM deduped
GROUP BY spawn_kind
ORDER BY spawn_kind
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_106'

spec.title: Subagent delegation pairs (who spawns whom)
spec.description:
Goal: See which subagent types tend to delegate to which other subagent types.
Description: Self-joins deduped agent_invocations on child.parent_agent_id = parent.agent_id, grouped by (parent subagent_type, child subagent_type), ranked by pair count descending.

spec.rawSql:
WITH deduped AS (
    SELECT
        ai.agent_id,
        argMax(ai.subagent_type, (ai.spawned_at, ai.subagent_type != '')) AS subagent_type,
        argMax(ai.parent_agent_id, (ai.spawned_at, ai.parent_agent_id != '')) AS parent_agent_id
    FROM agent_invocations ai
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT session_id, user_id
        FROM agent_events
        WHERE (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
          AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
          AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
          AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
          AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    ) ev ON ev.session_id = ai.session_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ai.spawned_at)
      AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ai.session_id))
      AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(ai.session_id), '')))
      AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(ai.session_id), '')))
      AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(ai.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
      AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR ai.session_id IN (
        SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
        WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
          AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
      ))
    GROUP BY ai.agent_id
)
SELECT
    parent.subagent_type AS parent_type,
    child.subagent_type AS child_type,
    count() AS pair_count
FROM deduped AS child
INNER JOIN deduped AS parent ON child.parent_agent_id = parent.agent_id
GROUP BY parent_type, child_type
ORDER BY pair_count DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_107'

spec.title: Delegation depth distribution
spec.description:
Goal: See how deep subagent delegation chains typically go, not just whether nesting happens at all.
Description: Buckets deduped agent_invocations into depth 1 (no parent), depth 2 (one level of nesting), and 3+ (grandparent itself nested), via a bounded two-level self-join rather than a full recursive tree walk.

spec.rawSql:
WITH deduped AS (
    SELECT
        ai.agent_id,
        argMax(ai.parent_agent_id, (ai.spawned_at, ai.parent_agent_id != '')) AS parent_agent_id
    FROM agent_invocations ai
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT session_id, user_id
        FROM agent_events
        WHERE (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
          AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
          AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
          AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
          AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    ) ev ON ev.session_id = ai.session_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ai.spawned_at)
      AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ai.session_id))
      AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(ai.session_id), '')))
      AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(ai.session_id), '')))
      AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(ai.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
      AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR ai.session_id IN (
        SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
        WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
          AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
      ))
    GROUP BY ai.agent_id
)
SELECT depth_bucket, spawn_count
FROM (
    SELECT 'depth 1' AS depth_bucket, count() AS spawn_count
    FROM deduped
    WHERE parent_agent_id IS NULL OR parent_agent_id = ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT if(is_grandparent_nested, '3+', 'depth 2') AS depth_bucket, spawn_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            (parent.parent_agent_id IS NOT NULL AND parent.parent_agent_id != '') AS is_grandparent_nested,
            count() AS spawn_count
        FROM deduped AS child
        INNER JOIN deduped AS parent ON child.parent_agent_id = parent.agent_id
        WHERE child.parent_agent_id IS NOT NULL AND child.parent_agent_id != ''
        GROUP BY is_grandparent_nested
    )
)
ORDER BY multiIf(depth_bucket = 'depth 1', 1, depth_bucket = 'depth 2', 2, 3)
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_108'

spec.title: Event mix by type over time
spec.description:
Goal: See whether the event-type mix is drifting over time - e.g. delegation share rising or transcript-handoff overhead growing - which a single snapshot can't show.
Description: Buckets calculated_type counts into ${window}-sized time intervals, one stacked series per type.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    calculated_type AS metric,
    count() AS value
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], session_id))
    AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(session_id), '')))
    AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(session_id), '')))
    AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR session_id IN (
      SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
      WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
        AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
    ))
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
  GROUP BY time, metric
)
SELECT time, metric, value
FROM filtered
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_109'

spec.title: MCP tool calls
spec.description:
Goal: See which MCP integrations are actually being exercised, and how reliably/quickly.
Description: Per mcp_tool_name (tool_name starting with 'mcp__'), counts successes/failures and computes p50/p95 latency_ms.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  tool_name,
  countIf(status = 'success') AS calls,
  countIf(status = 'failure') AS failures,
  quantile(0.5)(latency_ms) AS p50_ms,
  quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__')
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name))
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
GROUP BY tool_name
ORDER BY calls DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_11'

spec.title: Top 10 slowest tool calls
spec.description:
Goal: Drill into specific slow calls rather than only looking at aggregate percentiles.
Description: The 10 individual agent_events rows with the highest latency_ms in the selected time range, with the full call payload available via the eye-icon 'tool_detail' column.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  user_id,
  session_id,
  dictGetOrDefault('ai_gateway_users_dict', 'user_name', user_id, '') AS user_name,
  tool_name,
  latency_ms,
  calculated_payload AS tool_detail
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND status = 'success'
  AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND tool_name != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
ORDER BY latency_ms DESC
LIMIT 10
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_15'

spec.title: Tokens by model & scope over time
spec.description:
Goal: See which model+scope (subagent/skill/main session) combination consumes the most tokens.
Description: Buckets input/output tokens by time and by a concat of scope (derived via multiIf on agent_name/skill_name) and model.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    concat(multiIf(agent_name != '', 'subagent', skill_name != '', 'skill', 'main agent'), ' - ', model) AS metric,
    sum((input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (cache_creation_tokens + cache_read_tokens))) AS in_val,
    sum(output_tokens) AS out_val
  FROM agent_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_usage.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_usage.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_usage.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_usage.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], mcp_tool_name))
  GROUP BY time, metric
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT time, concat(metric, ' ↓') AS metric, toInt64(in_val) AS value FROM filtered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time, concat(metric, ' ↑') AS metric, toInt64(out_val) AS value FROM filtered
) ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_16'

spec.title: Cost by model & scope over time
spec.description:
Goal: See which model+scope combination costs the most - useful when a pricier/cheaper model shifts spend more than raw token volume alone would show.
Description: Cost counterpart to 'Tokens by model & scope over time' - sums input_cost/output_cost per time bucket, grouped by the same scope+model key.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    concat(multiIf(u.agent_name != '', 'subagent', u.skill_name != '', 'skill', 'main agent'), ' - ', u.model) AS metric,
    sum(u.input_cost) AS in_val,
    sum(u.output_cost) AS out_val
  FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
    AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
  GROUP BY time, metric
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT time, concat(metric, ' ↓') AS metric, in_val AS value FROM filtered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time, concat(metric, ' ↑') AS metric, out_val AS value FROM filtered
) ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_17'

spec.title: Users breakdown
spec.description:
Goal: See token/cost/duration usage for every user, not just the top few.
Description: Joins per-user token/cost sums from agent_usage to a CTE summing agent_events session durations per user, sorted by tokens_total descending by default - the token counterpart to 'Spend by user'.

spec.rawSql:
WITH session_durations_period AS (
  SELECT session_id, user_id, dateDiff('second', min(timestamp), max(timestamp)) AS duration_s
  FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  GROUP BY session_id, user_id
),
user_duration_period AS (
  SELECT user_id, sum(duration_s) AS duration_s FROM session_durations_period GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
  u.user_id AS user_id,
  any(dictGetOrDefault('ai_gateway_users_dict', 'user_name', u.user_id, '')) AS user_name,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens))) AS tokens_input,
  sum(u.output_tokens) AS tokens_output,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS tokens_total,
  sum(u.cost) AS cost,
  any(udp.duration_s) AS session_duration_s
FROM agent_usage u
LEFT JOIN user_duration_period udp ON udp.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY u.user_id
ORDER BY tokens_total DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_20'

spec.title: Cache hit rate by agent/skill/model over time
spec.description:
Goal: See whether prompt caching is actually landing for a given agent, skill, or model, and whether that's improving or regressing.
Description: cache_read_tokens / (cache_read_tokens + input_tokens) per time bucket, grouped by the same scope+model key as the token/cost panels.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    concat(multiIf(agent_name != '', 'subagent', skill_name != '', 'skill', 'main agent'), ' - ', model) AS metric,
    sum(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read,
    sum(input_tokens) AS input_tok
  FROM agent_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_usage.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_usage.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_usage.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_usage.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], mcp_tool_name))
  GROUP BY time, metric
)
SELECT time, metric, cache_read / nullIf(cache_read + input_tok, 0) AS value
FROM filtered
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_22'

spec.title: Agent version-change impact (before vs after adopting current version)
spec.description:
Goal: See whether adopting a new agent version measurably changed token/cost/error-rate compared to the version it replaced.
Description: Detects each agent's most recent version transition via lagInFrame over per-version first-seen timestamps, then averages usage/cost (agent_usage) and error rate (agent_events) before vs after that transition's start time.
Empty until an agent/skill actually has 2+ distinct versions observed in agent_usage - by design, this shows nothing for a brand-new agent/skill on its first version, not a query bug.

spec.rawSql:
WITH usage_f AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM agent_usage
  LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT session_id, argMax(git_branch, captured_at) AS git_branch, argMax(git_repo, captured_at) AS git_repo, argMax(issue_id, captured_at) AS issue_id
  FROM session_git_branch GROUP BY session_id
) gb ON gb.session_id = agent_usage.session_id
WHERE (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id)) AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR ('$provider' = 'claude' AND match(model, '^claude-')) OR ('$provider' = 'openai' AND match(model, '^(gpt-|chatgpt-|o[0-9]|text-embedding-|dall-e-|whisper|tts-)')) OR ('$provider' = 'other' AND NOT match(model, '^(claude-|gpt-|chatgpt-|o[0-9]|text-embedding-|dall-e-|whisper|tts-)')))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_usage.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], coalesce(gb.git_branch, ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], coalesce(gb.git_repo, ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(gb.issue_id, ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], mcp_tool_name))
),
events_f AS (
  SELECT * FROM agent_events
  LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT session_id, argMax(git_branch, captured_at) AS git_branch, argMax(git_repo, captured_at) AS git_repo, argMax(issue_id, captured_at) AS issue_id
  FROM session_git_branch GROUP BY session_id
) gb ON gb.session_id = agent_events.session_id
WHERE (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], coalesce(gb.git_branch, ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], coalesce(gb.git_repo, ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(gb.issue_id, ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
    AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
),
version_starts AS (
  SELECT agent_name, agent_version, min(timestamp) AS started_at
  FROM usage_f
  WHERE agent_name != ''
  GROUP BY agent_name, agent_version
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT *,
    lagInFrame(agent_version) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_name ORDER BY started_at) AS prev_version,
    lagInFrame(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_name ORDER BY started_at) AS prev_started_at,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY agent_name ORDER BY started_at DESC) AS rn
  FROM version_starts
),
transitions AS (
  SELECT agent_name, agent_version AS current_version, started_at, prev_version, prev_started_at
  FROM ordered
  WHERE rn = 1 AND prev_version != ''
),
usage_stats AS (
  SELECT t.agent_name, t.current_version, t.prev_version, t.started_at,
    avgIf((uf.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (uf.cache_creation_tokens + uf.cache_read_tokens)) + uf.output_tokens, uf.agent_version = t.current_version AND uf.timestamp >= t.started_at) AS avg_tokens_after,
    avgIf(uf.cost, uf.agent_version = t.current_version AND uf.timestamp >= t.started_at) AS avg_cost_after,
    avgIf((uf.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (uf.cache_creation_tokens + uf.cache_read_tokens)) + uf.output_tokens, uf.agent_version = t.prev_version AND uf.timestamp < t.started_at AND uf.timestamp >= t.prev_started_at) AS avg_tokens_before,
    avgIf(uf.cost, uf.agent_version = t.prev_version AND uf.timestamp < t.started_at AND uf.timestamp >= t.prev_started_at) AS avg_cost_before
  FROM transitions t
  LEFT JOIN usage_f uf ON uf.agent_name = t.agent_name
  GROUP BY t.agent_name, t.current_version, t.prev_version, t.started_at
),
events_stats AS (
  SELECT t.agent_name, t.current_version,
    countIf(ev.event_type = 'PostToolUseFailure' AND ev.agent_version = t.current_version AND ev.timestamp >= t.started_at) / nullIf(countIf(ev.event_type IN ('PostToolUse', 'PostToolUseFailure') AND ev.agent_version = t.current_version AND ev.timestamp >= t.started_at), 0) AS error_rate_after,
    countIf(ev.event_type = 'PostToolUseFailure' AND ev.agent_version = t.prev_version AND ev.timestamp < t.started_at AND ev.timestamp >= t.prev_started_at) / nullIf(countIf(ev.event_type IN ('PostToolUse', 'PostToolUseFailure') AND ev.agent_version = t.prev_version AND ev.timestamp < t.started_at AND ev.timestamp >= t.prev_started_at), 0) AS error_rate_before
  FROM transitions t
  LEFT JOIN events_f ev ON ev.agent_name = t.agent_name
  GROUP BY t.agent_name, t.current_version
)
SELECT
  us.agent_name, us.prev_version, us.current_version, us.started_at,
  us.avg_tokens_before, us.avg_tokens_after,
  us.avg_cost_before, us.avg_cost_after,
  es.error_rate_before, es.error_rate_after
FROM usage_stats us
LEFT JOIN events_stats es ON es.agent_name = us.agent_name AND es.current_version = us.current_version
ORDER BY us.agent_name
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_23'

  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], coalesce(gb.git_branch, ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], coalesce(gb.git_repo, ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(gb.issue_id, ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))

),
version_starts AS (
