spec.title: Error rate trend by tool
spec.description:
Goal: Spot a reliability regression on a specific tool as it happens, not just as a single aggregate number.
Description: Same error_rate formula as 'Error rate by tool' but bucketed by time, one series per tool_name.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  tool_name AS metric,
  countIf(status = 'failure') / nullIf(countIf(status IN ('success', 'failure')), 0) AS value
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND tool_name != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_27'

spec.title: Active users & sessions
spec.description:
Goal: Track whether the number of active people/sessions is growing or shrinking over the selected time window.
Description: Computes distinct users/sessions from agent_events bucketed into ${window}-sized intervals, matching the bucketing used across the rest of the dashboard.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  uniqExact(user_id) AS users,
  uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_29'

spec.title: Cost by dimension over time
spec.description:
Goal: Compare dollar cost across agents, skills, commands, MCP tools, or models over time, with the dimension user-selectable, or see one aggregate line via the "All" option.
Description: Cost counterpart to 'Tokens by dimension over time' - sums input_cost/output_cost per time bucket, grouped by the metric named for $cost_dimension (a single 'Total' series when $cost_dimension is 'all').

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    multiIf(
      '$cost_dimension' = 'agent', if(u.agent_name = '', 'main agent', if(u.agent_version = '', u.agent_name, concat(u.agent_name, ' v', u.agent_version))),
      '$cost_dimension' = 'skill', if(u.skill_name = '', 'main agent', if(u.skill_version = '', u.skill_name, concat(u.skill_name, ' v', u.skill_version))),
      '$cost_dimension' = 'command', u.command_name,
      '$cost_dimension' = 'mcp', u.mcp_tool_name,
      '$cost_dimension' = 'all', 'Total',
      u.model
    ) AS metric,
    sum(u.input_cost) AS in_val,
    sum(u.output_cost) AS out_val
  FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
    AND multiIf(
      '$cost_dimension' = 'agent', (u.agent_name != '' OR u.skill_name = ''),
      '$cost_dimension' = 'skill', u.skill_name != '',
      '$cost_dimension' = 'command', u.command_name != '',
      '$cost_dimension' = 'mcp', u.mcp_tool_name != '',
      '$cost_dimension' = 'all', true,
      (u.agent_name != '' OR u.skill_name = '')
    )
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
    AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
  GROUP BY time, metric
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT time, concat(metric, ' ↓') AS metric, in_val AS value FROM filtered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time, concat(metric, ' ↑') AS metric, out_val AS value FROM filtered
) ORDER BY time

spec.title: Failed tool calls
spec.description:
Goal: See recent individual tool-execution failures (not LLM-API-level failures) to debug what's actually breaking.
Description: Lists the most recent 20 agent_events rows with a non-empty failed_tool_name, showing failed_tool_args/failed_tool_error.
Recovered from message payloads at ingest time only, so this has no historical backfill - only shows failures from calls ingested after this panel was added.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  user_id,
  session_id,
  dictGetOrDefault('ai_gateway_users_dict', 'user_name', user_id, '') AS user_name,
  failed_tool_name AS tool_name,
  failed_tool_args AS arguments,
  failed_tool_error AS error
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND failed_tool_name != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(failed_tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], failed_tool_name)))
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_40'

spec.title: Tokens per call by dimension (bloat detector)
spec.description:
Goal: Catch a prompt/tool-set regression that makes an agent, skill, command, MCP tool, or model 'heavier' per call even if total volume looks flat, with the dimension user-selectable.
Description: Averages input+output tokens per litellm_call, bucketed by time, grouped by the metric named for $cost_dimension (agent+version, skill+version, command, mcp_tool_name, or model; a single 'Total' series when $cost_dimension is 'all') - a rising line means each individual call is getting more expensive, not just more frequent.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  multiIf(
    '$cost_dimension' = 'agent', if(u.agent_name = '', 'main agent', if(u.agent_version = '', u.agent_name, concat(u.agent_name, ' v', u.agent_version))),
    '$cost_dimension' = 'skill', if(u.skill_name = '', 'main agent', if(u.skill_version = '', u.skill_name, concat(u.skill_name, ' v', u.skill_version))),
    '$cost_dimension' = 'command', u.command_name,
    '$cost_dimension' = 'mcp', u.mcp_tool_name,
    '$cost_dimension' = 'all', 'Total',
    u.model
  ) AS metric,
  avg((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS value
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND multiIf(
    '$cost_dimension' = 'agent', (u.agent_name != '' OR u.skill_name = ''),
    '$cost_dimension' = 'skill', u.skill_name != '',
    '$cost_dimension' = 'command', u.command_name != '',
    '$cost_dimension' = 'mcp', u.mcp_tool_name != '',
    '$cost_dimension' = 'all', true,
    (u.agent_name != '' OR u.skill_name = '')
  )
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_110'

spec.description:
Goal: An early-warning signal for token bloat - text length grows before it shows up as a token-count regression, and it's readable without knowing model-specific tokenization.
Description: Averages character length of agent_messages.prompt_text/response_text per time bucket, grouped by skill_name (or agent_name when no skill applies).

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    if(skill_name = '', if(agent_name = '', 'main agent', agent_name), skill_name) AS metric,
    length(prompt_text) AS prompt_len,
    length(response_text) AS response_len
  FROM agent_messages
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_messages.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_messages.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_messages.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_messages.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_messages.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
),
agg AS (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(time, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time, metric,
         avg(prompt_len) AS avg_prompt, avg(response_len) AS avg_response
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY time, metric
)
SELECT time, concat(metric, suffix) AS metric, value
FROM agg
ARRAY JOIN [' prompt chars', ' response chars'] AS suffix, [avg_prompt, avg_response] AS value
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_43'

spec.title: Cache efficiency ratio by agent/skill
spec.description:
Goal: Distinguish 'caching happened at all' (the existing cache-hit-rate panel) from 'how much of the prompt was actually served from cache', which is what determines the dollar savings.
Description: cache_read_tokens / input_tokens (input_tokens already includes cache_read + cache_creation), per time bucket, grouped by agent_name (or skill_name when no agent applies).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  if(u.agent_name = '', if(u.skill_name = '', 'main agent', u.skill_name), u.agent_name) AS metric,
  sum(u.cache_read_tokens) / nullIf(sum(u.input_tokens), 0) AS value
FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_44'

spec.title: Cache tokens saved
spec.description:
Goal: Quantify how many tokens were actually served from cache instead of being recomputed as fresh input, as a volume companion to the cache-hit-rate ratio panels.
Description: Sums agent_usage.cache_creation_tokens + cache_read_tokens (joined in from agent_usage via litellm_call_id) per time bucket, grouped by agent_name (or skill_name when no agent applies).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(agent_events.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  if(agent_events.agent_name = '', if(agent_events.skill_name = '', 'main agent', agent_events.skill_name), agent_events.agent_name) AS metric,
  sum(au.cache_creation_tokens + au.cache_read_tokens) AS value
FROM agent_events
LEFT JOIN agent_usage au ON au.litellm_call_id = agent_events.litellm_call_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(agent_events.timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], agent_events.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], agent_events.group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_events.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], agent_events.skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], agent_events.command_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_45'

spec.title: TTFT (time to first token) p50/p95 by model
spec.description:
Goal: Track model responsiveness (how long before the model starts streaming) separately from total call duration, which 'Latency percentiles by tool_name' already covers.
Description: p50/p95 of agent_usage.ttft_ms (completionStartTime - startTime) for rows with ttft_ms > 0, bucketed by time, per model.

spec.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT u.timestamp AS time, u.model AS metric, u.ttft_ms AS ttft_ms
  FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp) AND u.ttft_ms > 0
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], u.agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], u.skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  AND (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], u.mcp_tool_name))
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(time, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time, concat(metric, ' p50') AS metric, quantile(0.5)(ttft_ms) AS value FROM filtered GROUP BY time, metric
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(time, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time, concat(metric, ' p95') AS metric, quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms) AS value FROM filtered GROUP BY time, metric
) ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_46'

spec.title: Stop-reason mix over time
spec.description:
Goal: Catch two failure modes a plain error-rate panel misses because the call still counts as 'success' - answers getting cut off (max_tokens) or refused (refusal) instead of ending cleanly.
Description: Stacked count of agent_usage.stop_reason per time bucket.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  u.stop_reason AS metric,

FROM agent_usage u
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp) AND u.stop_reason != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))

  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))

SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_47'

spec.title: Retry / self-correction rate by agent & skill
spec.description:
Goal: A direct quality signal for a skill/prompt - how often the model has to react to its own failed tool call, versus succeeding cleanly the first time.
Description: Share of agent_events rows where failed_tool_name != '' (this call is responding to a tool_result marked is_error), per time bucket, grouped by agent_name (or skill_name when no agent applies).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  if(agent_name = '', if(skill_name = '', 'main agent', skill_name), agent_name) AS metric,

FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))

  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (

  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))

  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_48'

spec.title: API-level failure reasons over time
spec.description:
Goal: Tell platform-level failures (rate limits, overload, auth) apart from tool-execution failures, which never carry a tool_name since the call failed before any tool ran.
Description: Stacked count of agent_events rows with status='failure', grouped by error_type extracted from calculated_payload JSON, per time bucket.

spec.rawSql:
WITH failures AS (
  SELECT timestamp, agent_events.calculated_payload AS calculated_payload
  FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND status = 'failure'
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
)
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  if(JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'error_type') = '', 'unknown', JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'error_type')) AS metric,
  count() AS value
FROM failures
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_49'

spec.title: Error rate by tool
spec.description:
Goal: Flag which tools are least reliable right now.
Description: countIf(status='failure') divided by total success+failure calls, grouped by tool_name, over the selected range.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  tool_name,
  countIf(status = 'success') AS successes,
  countIf(status = 'failure') AS failures,
  countIf(status = 'failure') / nullIf(countIf(status = 'success') + countIf(status = 'failure'), 0) AS error_rate
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND tool_name != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
GROUP BY tool_name
ORDER BY error_rate DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_5'

spec.title: Top repeating tool errors
spec.description:
Goal: 'Failed tool calls' lists individual failures - this instead groups them, so a single misbehaving tool call pattern (bad args, flaky dependency) shows up as one row with a count instead of many identical-looking entries.
Description: Groups agent_events by failed_tool_name + failed_tool_error, ranked by occurrence count, with the full error text available via the eye-icon column.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  failed_tool_name AS tool_name,
  count() AS occurrences,
  max(timestamp) AS last_seen,
  failed_tool_error
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND failed_tool_name != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(failed_tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], failed_tool_name)))
GROUP BY tool_name, failed_tool_error
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_50'

spec.title: Command adoption
spec.description:
Goal: See which slash commands actually got adopted versus shipped-but-unused, which the token/cost-by-command trend panels don't answer directly.
Description: One row per command_name with call count, distinct session count, and first/last-seen timestamps, ranked by call count.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  command_name,
  count() AS calls,
  count(distinct session_id) AS sessions,
  min(timestamp) AS first_seen,
  max(timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND command_name != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
GROUP BY command_name
ORDER BY calls DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_51'

spec.title: Subagent spawns over time by type
spec.description:
Goal: Catch an orchestrator/prompt change that starts spawning more (or fewer) subagents than before - a fan-out regression that token/cost panels only show indirectly.
Description: Counts agent_invocations rows (one per Agent tool_use recovered from the orchestrator's own messages) per time bucket, per subagent_type, inner-joined to a distinct session/user list from agent_events so the existing user/agent/skill/command filters still apply.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(ai.spawned_at, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  replaceRegexpOne(ai.subagent_type, '_(v[0-9][0-9.]*)$', ' \\1') AS metric,
  count() AS value
FROM agent_invocations ai
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_id, user_id
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
    AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
) ev ON ev.session_id = ai.session_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ai.spawned_at)
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], ai.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(ai.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(ai.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(ai.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR ai.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_52'

spec.title: Session cost distribution

Description: Histogram of total cost per session_id (agent_usage.cost summed per session) over the selected time range.

SELECT session_id, sum(cost) AS total_cost

  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))

spec.title: Cost by subagent type over time
spec.description:
Goal: See which subagent types actually drive spend.
Description: Inner-joins agent_usage.agent_invocation_id to agent_invocations.agent_id to resolve subagent_type, sums cost per time bucket grouped by that type - the same join key already used elsewhere in the schema but not previously wired into any panel, so this cost was invisible before.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  ai.subagent_type AS metric,
  sum(u.cost) AS value
FROM agent_usage u
INNER JOIN agent_invocations ai ON ai.agent_id = u.agent_invocation_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND u.agent_invocation_id != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_58'

spec.title: Tokens by subagent type over time
spec.description:
Goal: See which subagent types consume the most tokens.
Description: Same agent_invocation_id -> agent_id join as 'Cost by subagent type over time', summing input+output tokens per time bucket instead.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
  ai.subagent_type AS metric,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS value
FROM agent_usage u
INNER JOIN agent_invocations ai ON ai.agent_id = u.agent_invocation_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND u.agent_invocation_id != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_59'

spec.title: Latency percentiles (p50/p95) by tool_name
spec.description:
Goal: Flag which tools are slow, independent of the error-rate view.
Description: p50/p95 of agent_events.latency_ms (full call duration, endTime-startTime) grouped by tool_name; distinct from ttft_ms, which measures only time-to-first-token.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  tool_name,
  quantile(0.5)(latency_ms) AS p50_ms,
  quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms
FROM agent_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND status = 'success'
  AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND tool_name != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
  AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name))
  AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name))
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name))
  AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
GROUP BY tool_name
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_6'

spec.title: Top subagent types by cost
spec.description:
Goal: Rank subagent types to decide which is worth optimizing first.
Description: Same agent_invocations join, aggregated to totals (cost, tokens, call count) over the whole selected range, ranked by cost descending, limited to 15.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ai.subagent_type AS subagent_type,
  sum(u.cost) AS cost,
  sum((u.input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (u.cache_creation_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens)) + u.output_tokens) AS tokens,
  count() AS calls
FROM agent_usage u
INNER JOIN agent_invocations ai ON ai.agent_id = u.agent_invocation_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
  AND u.agent_invocation_id != ''
  AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
  AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
  AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
  AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
  AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
GROUP BY subagent_type
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 15
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_60'

spec.title: Subagent call outcome by type (success/failure)
spec.description:
Goal: Spot a subagent type whose calls fail disproportionately.
Description: Counts agent_events rows per time bucket, grouped by subagent_type (via the agent_invocation_id -> agent_id join) concatenated with status, so success/failure trends per type are visible side by side.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(e.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,

FROM agent_events e
INNER JOIN agent_invocations ai ON ai.agent_id = e.agent_invocation_id

  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR e.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], e.command_name))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_61'

spec.title: Cache creation tokens by TTL (1h vs 5m)
spec.description:
Goal: See how much prompt-cache writing goes to the cheaper-but-longer-lived 1h tier vs the 5m tier that expires between widely-spaced requests.
Description: Unions two per-time-bucket sums, cache_creation_1h_tokens and cache_creation_5m_tokens, as separate series; a rising 5m share usually means requests are landing far enough apart that the longer cache window isn't being reused.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    'ephemeral 1h' AS metric,
    sum(u.cache_creation_1h_tokens) AS value
  FROM agent_usage u
  WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
    AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  GROUP BY time
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(u.timestamp, INTERVAL ${window} SECOND) AS time,
    'ephemeral 5m' AS metric,
    sum(u.cache_creation_5m_tokens) AS value
  FROM agent_usage u
  WHERE $__timeFilter(u.timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], u.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], u.group_id))
    AND (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], u.model)) AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR u.provider = '$provider')
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], u.session_id))
    AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(u.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
    AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], u.command_name))
  GROUP BY time
) ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_62'

spec.title: Cache hit rate over time (overall)
spec.description:

Description: cache_read_tokens / input_tokens (input_tokens already includes cache_read + cache_creation), aggregated across everything currently selected, per time bucket.

GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_64'

spec.title: /goal invocations over time

spec.rawSql:

  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (

spec.title: /goal usage log
spec.description:
Goal: See the detail behind each individual /goal invocation - who ran it, how long it took, and what was asked.
Description: One row per session (= one invocation, since turn_id is currently always 0): joins per-session call count/duration from agent_events to input/output token and cost totals from agent_usage and the first prompt text extracted from calculated_payload. Click the value in 'arguments' to see the full text.

spec.rawSql:
WITH goal_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    agent_events.session_id AS session_id,
    min(timestamp) AS started_at,
    max(timestamp) AS last_call_at,
    count() AS calls,
    any(agent_events.user_id) AS session_user_id,
    any(dictGetOrDefault('ai_gateway_users_dict', 'user_name', agent_events.user_id, '')) AS session_user_name
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE command_name = 'goal'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND (has([${user_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${user_id:singlequote}], agent_events.user_id))
    AND (has([${group_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${group_id:singlequote}], group_id))
    AND (has([${session_id:singlequote}], '') OR has([${session_id:singlequote}], agent_events.session_id))
    AND (has([${git_branch:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_branch:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_branch', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${git_repo:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${git_repo:singlequote}], dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'git_repo', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''))) AND (has([${issue_id:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${issue_id:singlequote}], coalesce(nullIf(dictGetOrDefault('session_git_branch_dict', 'issue_id', cityHash64(agent_events.session_id), ''), ''), 'empty')))
  AND ((has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') AND '$provider' = 'all') OR agent_events.session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM agent_usage
    WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
      AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
  ))
  GROUP BY agent_events.session_id
),
prompts AS (
  SELECT session_id,
    argMin(replaceRegexpOne(JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'display_text'), '^/goal ', ''), timestamp) AS prompt_text
  FROM agent_events
  WHERE command_name = 'goal' AND JSONExtractString(calculated_payload, 'display_text') != ''
  GROUP BY session_id
),
usage AS (
  SELECT session_id, sum((input_tokens - (1 - $include_cache_tokens) * (cache_creation_tokens + cache_read_tokens))) AS tokens_input, sum(output_tokens) AS tokens_output, sum(cost) AS cost
  FROM agent_usage
  GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT
  gs.started_at AS timestamp,
  gs.session_user_id AS user_id,
  gs.session_id AS session_id,
  gs.session_user_name AS user_name,
  gs.calls AS "llm calls",
  round(dateDiff('second', gs.started_at, gs.last_call_at) / 60.0, 2) AS "duration (min)",
  coalesce(u.tokens_input, 0) AS tokens_input,
  coalesce(u.tokens_output, 0) AS tokens_output,
  coalesce(u.cost, 0) AS cost,
  p.prompt_text AS "arguments"
FROM goal_sessions gs
LEFT JOIN prompts p ON p.session_id = gs.session_id
LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.session_id = gs.session_id
ORDER BY gs.started_at DESC
SETTINGS log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_68'

spec.title: Spend by ${git_dimension}

      WHERE (has([${model:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${model:singlequote}], model))
        AND ('$provider' = 'all' OR provider = '$provider')
    )) AND (has([${agent_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${agent_name:singlequote}], agent_name)) AND (has([${skill_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${skill_name:singlequote}], skill_name)) AND (has([${command_name:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${command_name:singlequote}], command_name)) AND (NOT startsWith(tool_name, 'mcp__') OR (has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], '__all__') OR has([${mcp_tool:singlequote}], tool_name)))
) ev

spec.title: Trace: $session_id
spec.description: Goal: See what a session actually did, step by step - prompts, replies, tool calls, and sub-agent spawns, in order. Description: One chronological list per session showing each prompt/reply/tool call with duration, tokens, and cost; sub-agent calls are indented under their parent to show nesting. Click a timestamp to see that step's full tool-call arguments below.
